reading.title: A quiet friend
reading.content: My friend Dilshod is a very calm and thoughtful person. He rarely raises his voice and listens carefully before giving advice. He is tall and thin, with short dark hair and glasses. Even in a crowded room he looks relaxed and never seems in a hurry.
reading.translationUz: Mening do‘stim Dilshod juda bosiq va o‘ychan odam. U kam ovoz ko‘taradi va maslahat berishdan oldin diqqat bilan tinglaydi. U bo‘yi baland va ozg‘in, qisqa qora soch va ko‘zoynak taqadi. Hatto odam ko‘p xonada ham xotirjam ko‘rinadi va hech qachon shoshilayotganga o‘xshamaydi.

questions.question: How does he behave in a crowded room?

reading.title: At the new apartment
reading.content: I just moved into a small apartment near the park. It has one bedroom, a bright kitchen, and a tiny balcony with a view of the trees. The building is old but well-maintained, and my neighbours seem quiet and friendly. I still need to buy a desk and a lamp for the corner by the window.
reading.translationUz: Men bog‘ yaqinidagi kichik kvartiraga ko‘chib keldim. Bitta xona, yorug‘ oshxona va daraxtlarga qaraydigan kichkina balkon bor. Bino eski, lekin yaxshi saqlangan, qo‘shnilarim esa jim va xushmuomala ko‘rinadi. Deraza yonidagi burchakka hali stol va chiroq olishim kerak.

reading.title: An honest colleague
reading.content: At my previous job I worked with a colleague named Aziza, who was known for being honest and reliable. She never promised what she could not deliver and always admitted when she did not know something. Her honesty saved the team from several mistakes, because people trusted her feedback.
reading.translationUz: Oldingi ishimda Aziza ismli hamkasbim bilan ishlardim, u halol va ishonchli ekanligi bilan tanilgandi. U bajara olmaydigan narsasini hech qachon va'da qilmasdi va bilmagan narsasini doim tan olardi. Uning halolligi jamoani bir necha xatolardan asradi, chunki odamlar uning fikriga ishonishardi.

reading.title: The old library
reading.content: There is an old library in the city centre that still uses paper index cards. The reading room has tall windows and dark wooden tables. Even on busy days it stays silent — people whisper, phones are off, and the only sound is pages turning. Many students prefer it to the modern campus library.
reading.translationUz: Shahar markazida eski kutubxona bor, u hali ham qog‘oz kartochkalardan foydalanadi. O‘qish zalida baland derazalar va to‘q yog‘och stollar bor. Band kunlarda ham u jim bo‘ladi — odamlar pichirlashadi, telefonlar o‘chirilgan, yagona tovush — bu sahifa ag‘darilishi. Ko‘plab talabalar uni zamonaviy kampus kutubxonasidan afzal ko‘radi.

reading.title: A talkative taxi driver
reading.content: On my way to the airport, the taxi driver would not stop talking. He asked about my job, my family, and my opinion on the city traffic. Although he was friendly, I was tired and only wanted to think about my trip. In the end I thanked him politely and gave him a small tip.
reading.translationUz: Aeroportga ketayotganimda, taksi haydovchisi gapirishdan to‘xtamadi. U mening ishim, oilam va shahardagi tirbandlik haqidagi fikrimni so‘radi. Garchi u xushmuomala bo‘lsa-da, men charchagan edim va faqat sayohatim haqida o‘ylashni xohlardim. Oxirida muloyimlik bilan rahmat aytib, kichik chayyot berdim.

questions.question: What did the speaker give the driver?

words.example: She has a crush on him.
